about_the_game:
2012. Arctic Research Station "Persei".

You are Ethan Miller, a junior technician stationed at an isolated scientific base in the northern Kara Sea. The routine is strict, as always: maintenance tasks, daily reports, quiet evenings beside humming radiators. Just another standard shift.

Until the anomalies begin — minor malfunctions, strange noises from the technical wing, missing tools, and that unsettling feeling that you’re no longer alone.

Gradually, your familiar routine spirals into paranoia. Communications become unstable. Your colleagues grow tense. Unusual logs begin surfacing in the archives. And the deeper you dig into the events of recent months, the clearer it becomes: something went wrong. Long ago. And there may be no way back.

Key Features:

  • A Deep, Story-Driven Mystery
    Uncover what lies behind the locked doors of a forgotten station — and what price was paid in the pursuit of progress.

  • Atmospheric Psychological Horror
    Immersive sound design, detailed lighting, and realistic visuals draw you into the cold, creeping dread of the Arctic.

  • Exploration-Focused Gameplay
    Navigate tangled corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and make crucial decisions that shape how the story unfolds.

  • Meticulous Worldbuilding
    From rusted instruments to worn-out logs, every asset is crafted with attention to detail — enhancing immersion and narrative depth.

  • Fragmented Storytelling
    Every message, item, and hidden space reveals another piece of the puzzle — blurring the line between reality and madness.

Prepare Yourself:

You are the last person who might discover what happened to Station Persei — and possibly survive it. But to do so, you’ll need to face not just an unknown threat... but your own fear.

“Insomnia: Chapter One” invites you into a tense and chilling journey through the frozen halls of a decaying facility — where the cold is not the only thing creeping in.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: With 3D sound support
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: 2012. The Arctic research station "Persei" loses contact with the outside world. You are Ethan Miller, a technician sent to the facility to fix the issues. But something here has clearly gone out of control.
